groups.name: issues
groups.title: Issues: search, read, create, edit, link, commands, history

tools.name: search_issues
tools.title: Search issues
tools.summary: Searches issues with the YouTrack query language and returns id, summary, project, resolved, reporter, created, updated and the requested custom fields.

tools.name: count_issues
tools.title: Count issues
tools.summary: Counts issues matching a YouTrack search query without fetching them.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.title: Get issue
tools.summary: Returns full details of an issue: summary, description, URL, project, reporter, tags, votes, custom fields, links, attachments and the most recent comments.

tools.name: get_issue_fields_schema
tools.title: Get issue fields schema
tools.summary: Returns a JSON Schema of the project's custom fields with allowed values.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.title: Create issue
tools.summary: Creates an issue.

tools.name: create_draft_issue
tools.title: Create draft issue
tools.summary: Creates an issue draft visible only to the current user.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.title: Update issue
tools.summary: Updates an issue: summary, description, a subset of custom fields, star (subscription) and vote.

tools.name: edit_issue_description
tools.title: Edit issue description
tools.summary: Changes part of an issue's description by exact find-and-replace, without resending the whole text.

tools.name: change_issue_assignee
tools.title: Change issue assignee
tools.summary: Sets the Assignee of an issue.

tools.name: delete_issue
tools.title: Delete issue
tools.summary: Permanently deletes an issue or a draft, with its comments, attachments and work items.

tools.name: apply_command
tools.title: Apply command
tools.summary: Applies a YouTrack command to one or more issues, the same as the command dialog in the UI: set fields, assign, tag, move to another project, add links, vote, star and more in one line.

tools.name: get_issue_activities
tools.title: Get issue activities
tools.summary: Returns the change history of an issue: who changed which field, comments, links, tags, attachments, sprints and work items, with old and new values.

tools.name: link_issues
tools.title: Link issues
tools.summary: Links two issues.

tools.name: unlink_issues
tools.title: Unlink issues
tools.summary: Removes a link between two issues; arguments mirror link_issues.

tools.name: get_issue_vcs_changes
tools.title: Get issue VCS changes
tools.summary: Returns commits and pull requests linked to an issue through a VCS integration (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, TeamCity): version, message, author, date and links.

tools.name: get_issue_comments
tools.title: Get issue comments
tools.summary: Returns comments of an issue, oldest first.

tools.name: add_issue_comment
tools.title: Add issue comment
tools.summary: Adds a comment to an issue, optionally visible only to given users and groups.

tools.name: update_issue_comment
tools.title: Update issue comment
tools.summary: Replaces the text of an issue comment.

tools.name: restore_issue_comment
tools.title: Restore issue comment
tools.summary: Restores a comment that was deleted (not permanently) with delete_issue_comment or in the UI.

tools.name: delete_issue_comment
tools.title: Delete issue comment
tools.summary: Deletes a comment from an issue.

tools.name: get_issue_attachments
tools.title: Get attachments
tools.summary: Lists the attachments of an issue or a knowledge base article: ID, file name, size, type, author and date.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.title: Get attachment
tools.summary: Reads an attachment of an issue or article.

tools.name: add_attachment
tools.title: Add attachment
tools.summary: Attaches local files (filePath, or several with filePaths), or the given text as a file, to an issue or a knowledge base article.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.title: Delete attachment
tools.summary: Permanently deletes an attachment from an issue or article.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.title: Search articles
tools.summary: Searches the knowledge base.

tools.name: get_article
tools.title: Get article
tools.summary: Returns an article: title, content, parent and sub-articles, tags, attachments and visibility.

tools.name: create_article
tools.title: Create article
tools.summary: Creates a knowledge base article, optionally under a parent article and with limited visibility.

tools.name: update_article
tools.title: Update article
tools.summary: Changes the title, content or parent of an article.

tools.name: edit_article_content
tools.title: Edit article content
tools.summary: Changes part of an article's content by exact find-and-replace, without resending the whole text.

tools.name: delete_article
tools.title: Delete article
tools.summary: Permanently deletes a knowledge base article.

tools.name: log_work
tools.title: Log work
tools.summary: Adds a spent time work item to an issue.

tools.name: get_issue_work_items
tools.title: Get issue work items
tools.summary: Returns spent time work items of an issue, oldest first, with total minutes.

tools.name: delete_work_item
tools.title: Delete work item
tools.summary: Permanently deletes a spent time work item.

tools.name: get_time_report
tools.title: Get time report
tools.summary: Summarizes spent time across issues: total and per author, issue, work type, day or project, filtered by issue query, author and period.

tools.name: find_agile_boards
tools.title: Find agile boards
tools.summary: Finds agile boards whose name or project key contains a substring (case-insensitive).

tools.name: get_agile_board
tools.title: Get agile board
tools.summary: Returns an agile board: projects, owner, columns and the field they map to, estimation field, sprint settings, the current sprint and recent sprints.

tools.name: get_sprint
tools.title: Get sprint
tools.summary: Returns a sprint of an agile board (the current one by default): name, goal, dates, archived flag and its issues with board-relevant custom fields.

tools.name: create_sprint
tools.title: Create sprint
tools.summary: Creates a sprint on an agile board that uses sprints.

tools.name: update_sprint
tools.title: Update sprint
tools.summary: Changes a sprint's name, goal or dates, or archives and restores it.

tools.name: add_issue_to_sprint
tools.title: Add issue to sprint
tools.summary: Adds an issue to a sprint (the current one by default) of an agile board.

tools.name: remove_issue_from_sprint
tools.title: Remove issue from sprint
tools.summary: Removes an issue from a sprint (the current one by default) of an agile board.

tools.name: delete_sprint
tools.title: Delete sprint
tools.summary: Permanently deletes a sprint from an agile board.

tools.name: find_projects
tools.title: Find projects
tools.summary: Finds projects whose name or key contains a substring (case-insensitive).

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.summary: Returns project details: key, name, description, leader, custom field names and time tracking settings including work types and work item attributes (for log_work).

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.summary: Returns login, email, full name and time zone of the current user.

tools.name: find_user
tools.title: Find user
tools.summary: Finds a user by login or email.

tools.name: find_user_groups
tools.title: Find user groups
tools.summary: Finds user groups and project teams whose name contains a substring (case-insensitive).

tools.name: get_user_group_members
tools.title: Get user group members
tools.summary: Returns members of a user group or project team: login, full name and email.

tools.name: manage_issue_tags
tools.title: Manage issue tags
tools.summary: Adds a tag to an issue or removes it.

tools.name: find_tags
tools.title: Find tags
tools.summary: Finds tags visible to the current user by name substring.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.title: Create tag
tools.summary: Creates a tag owned by the current user.

tools.name: update_tag
tools.title: Update tag
tools.summary: Renames a tag.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.title: Delete tag
tools.summary: Permanently deletes a tag and removes it from all issues.

tools.name: get_saved_issue_searches
tools.title: Get saved issue searches
tools.summary: Returns the current user's favorite saved issue searches.

tools.name: create_saved_search
tools.title: Create saved search
tools.summary: Saves a search query under a name.

tools.name: update_saved_search
tools.title: Update saved search
tools.summary: Renames a saved search or changes its query.

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.title: Delete saved search
tools.summary: Permanently deletes a saved search.

tools.name: call_api
tools.title: Call YouTrack REST API
tools.summary: Calls any YouTrack (or Hub) REST endpoint as the current user, for what no other tool covers.

prompts.name: issue_brief
prompts.title: Issue brief
prompts.description: Catch up on an issue: what it is about, where it stands, what was decided and what's open.

prompts.name: sprint_report
prompts.title: Sprint report
prompts.description: Status of a sprint on an agile board: done and open work, who has what, scope changes, time and risks.

prompts.name: standup
prompts.title: Stand-up update
prompts.description: My stand-up from YouTrack: what I did since the last working day, what's next, what blocks me.

prompts.name: triage
prompts.title: Triage issues
prompts.description: Go through untriaged issues of a project and propose type, priority, assignee and duplicates; applies only what I approve.

agents.name: anthropic
agents.about: Claude Code on an Anthropic-compatible API

agents.name: openai
agents.about: Claude Code on an OpenAI-compatible API

strategies.name: branch
strategies.about: push the branch; you open pull or merge requests yourself

strategies.name: github-pr
strategies.about: push and open a GitHub pull request

strategies.name: github-issue-pr
strategies.about: also open a GitHub issue the pull request closes

strategies.name: gitlab-mr
strategies.about: push and open a GitLab merge request
